about: What Ozi says to Shop Partners (ruling 44). Kept on the server only.

replies: Hello. Welcome to your Shop Partner area. Say help to hear what I can do.
Hi there. Ready to add some products?
You're welcome. Thank you for being a {product} Shop Partner.
My pleasure.
Very well, thank you. How's business today?
I'm well. Shall we look at your products?
The Shop Partner plan is {partnerPlan} a month.
{partnerPlan} a month, for your own area, products and page.

when: what do i get for my plan
what is the shop partner plan
replies: Your own sign-in, your products and prices shown in the app, your own shop page, and a link to share.
Your products and prices in front of every Shopper nearby, with a page and a link of your own.

when: what happens if i stop paying
replies: Your products are hidden until it's paid again. Nothing is deleted.
They're kept, just hidden, until the plan is paid.
Every shop can be listed free. Shop Partners pay to show their own products and prices, and update them themselves.
Listing is free. The partner plan is for showing your own products.
With Spotlight, at {spotlight} a month, I mention your shop to Shoppers looking for what you sell, up to once a week each.
Spotlight is {spotlight} a month: I tell Shoppers your shop has what they're looking for.
Spotlight Plus is {spotlightPlus} a month: up to three mentions a week to each Shopper.
{spotlightPlus} a month, for up to three mentions a week each.
Spotlight is on top of your plan. You need the plan first.
It's an extra on top of the {partnerPlan} plan.

when: how do you mention my shop
what do you say about my shop
replies: After my own answer, I say it's an advert, and that your product is in stock at your shop, with the price.
I call it an advert and give facts only: in stock, where, and about how much.

when: will you say my shop is the best
replies: No. I only give facts people can check, like in stock or nearby. Never better.
Only checkable facts. That keeps Shoppers trusting what I say.

when: how do i add a product
replies: Say add a product and I'll ask its name, price and best before date. Or use the form with a photo.
Say add a product, or fill in the form on the screen.

when: how long until my product is live
replies: We check each new product, usually within one working day.
Usually within a working day.

when: why was my product turned down
replies: The note on it says why. Usually the name, price or photo needs checking.
Read the note beside it, fix it, and send it again.

when: how do i change a price
replies: Say change the price of, then the product, then the new amount. It changes straight away.
Prices change at once, by voice or on the screen.

when: how do i remove a product
replies: Say remove and the product's name. Shoppers stop seeing it at once.
Say remove, then the product.
Yes. Take one with your phone in the add a product form. It helps people choose.
Add one in the form. A clear photo sells.
Add it when you add the product, so Shoppers know how fresh it is.
Give it with the product. It's optional but helpful.
Never alcohol, tobacco, medicines, cash or anything age restricted.
None of those. We never deliver them.

when: how should i name my product
replies: Say it as a Shopper would look for it, with the size, like sourdough loaf, 800 grams.
Plain and clear, with the size.
Labels are extra words to help people find it, like bread, gluten free, or vegan.
Extra search words, like bakery or halal.

when: how do i share my shop
replies: Say share my link, or press share on the screen. Send it to customers, friends and other shops.
Press share my shop's link.
Your meter shows how many people opened an account through your link, towards 100.
Look at the meter under your link.
Say how am I doing, and I'll tell you this week's and this month's purchases from your shop.
Your numbers are on the screen: purchases this week and this month.
Say my payment history, or download your statement as a PDF.
It's under what you have paid, with a PDF to download.
Speak to our partnerships team to pay or renew. It shows here once it's recorded.
Our team takes the payment and records it here.
A Runner comes and buys from you as an ordinary customer. You don't need to do anything different.
Our Runners shop in your shop like anyone else.
No commission on what Runners buy. You pay the monthly plan, and Spotlight if you choose it.
No commission. Just the plan.
I'm {assistant}, the {product} assistant. I'm here to help your shop.
I'm {assistant}. {motto}
Many of our Shoppers are blind, partially sighted or elderly, and some are cared for by organisations.
People who find it hard to get to the shops, and the families and organisations who help them.
We're growing every week. Your figures show what our Shoppers buy from you.
Growing fast. Your numbers show your share.
You can say: add a product, read my products, change a price, remove a product, what do I pay, my payment history, how am I doing, my spotlight, share my link.
Ask me to add, change or remove a product, or about your plan, Spotlight, payments or numbers.
Say sign me out and I'll do it.
Just say sign me out.
Ask our team for a new password. You choose your own the first time you sign in.
Our team can give you a new one.
Tell our team straight away, and we'll give you a new password and sign everyone else out.
Contact us at once. We'll lock it and reset it.

when: can i see who bought from me
replies: No. Shoppers' names and details are private. You see the numbers, not the people.
Only numbers, never names. That's the law, and it's fair.
Not directly. Spotlight is how I can tell Shoppers about you.
Through Spotlight and your shared link.
Yes. Tell our partnerships team the offer in writing, and it goes on the Offers page.
Agree it with our team and it appears under Offers.
Try again closer and in good light. Very large photos are made smaller for you.
Take it again in good light.
Goodbye. Good trading.
See you soon.
Speak to our team. While it's not paid, your products are simply hidden.
Talk to us. Nothing is lost while it's paused.
Your numbers grow with time. Ask our team about Shop Partner insights when they're ready.
As purchases build up, we'll show you what sells.

when: how many products can i add
replies: As many as you sell, one at a time. Each is checked once.
No fixed limit.

when: can i add a product without a photo
replies: Yes, a photo is optional, but it helps.
Yes. You can add the photo later by sending it again.

when: how many times have you mentioned my shop
replies: Say my spotlight, and I'll tell you how many mentions this month.
It's in your Spotlight section.

when: can blind people run a shop with you
replies: Yes. Everything here works by voice and with a screen reader.
Completely. Talk to me, or use a screen reader.
Only our team. Your sign-in is protected and your password is never stored as itself.
Kept private, protected, and never sold.

when: what if a runner has a problem in my shop
replies: Tell our team. We'll sort it out quickly and fairly.
Let us know, we'll deal with it.
No long contract. It's month by month.
Month by month.
Choose the Shop Partner door on the first screen, then type your username and password.
Use the Shop Partner door, with the username our team gave you.
Our partnerships team gave you your username. Ask them and they'll remind you.
Ask our team. They can tell you your username.
Welcome. Type the password our team gave you, then choose your own. It must be at least ten characters.
Use the password you were given once, then pick your own of at least ten characters.

when: how do i change my password
replies: Use change password in your area. You type your current one, then the new one, at least ten characters.
In your area, choose change password. Type it, never say it aloud.

when: shall i tell you my password
replies: Please don't say it aloud. Passwords are always typed, so nobody nearby hears them. I'll never ask for it.
No, never. Type it yourself. I don't need it and I'll never ask.
After five wrong tries you wait fifteen minutes, then try again. Or ask our team to reset it.
Wait fifteen minutes and try again, or our team can give you a new password.

when: it says my password is wrong
username and password do not match
replies: Check the username and type the password slowly. If it still fails, our team can reset it.
Try once more carefully. Our team can give you a new one if needed.
Yes. Ask our partnerships team and they'll give each person their own sign-in for your shop.
Our team can add a sign-in for each person who helps in your shop.

when: can my son use my sign in
replies: Better not. Ask our team for a separate sign-in for each person. Then nobody needs your password.
Each person should have their own. Our team can set that up.

when: can i sign in on my phone
does it work on a phone
replies: Yes. Your area works on a phone, a tablet or a computer.
Yes, on any phone with a web browser.

when: can i sign in on two devices
sign in on the shop computer too
replies: Yes. Sign in wherever is handy. Say sign me out when you leave a shared one.
You can. Remember to sign out on a shared computer.

when: do i have to sign in every time
replies: You may need to sign in again now and then. That keeps your shop's area safe.
Now and then you'll sign in again, for safety.

when: signed in on the till computer
replies: Then say sign me out when you've finished, so nobody else can change your products.
Sign out when you're done. It keeps your shop safe.
That can happen for safety. Just sign in again with your username and password.
Sign in again. Nothing you saved is lost.

when: where is the shop partner door
replies: On the first screen there's a choice for Shop Partners. Choose it to sign in.
It's one of the choices at the top of the first screen.

when: can i sign in by voice
replies: You can tell me you're a shop, and I'll take you to the right door. The password you always type yourself.
I'll take you to the Shop Partner door. Then type your password; never say it.

when: is there two step sign in
replies: Not for Shop Partners at the moment. Choose a long password and keep it to yourself.
Not yet. A long password of your own is your protection.

when: someone else signed in as me
replies: Tell our partnerships team straight away. They can give you a new password and check what changed.
Contact our team at once and change your password.

when: a message asked for my password
replies: We never ask for your password, by message, call or here. Don't give it. Tell our team about the message.
Never share it. We'll never ask. Please let our team know.

when: will you ever ask for a code
do you need my bank details
should i give you my card number
replies: No. I never ask for passwords, codes or card numbers. Please never say them to me.
Never. Keep those private.

when: my old employee still has access
replies: Ask our partnerships team to close that person's sign-in. Change your own password too if they knew it.
Our team can close their sign-in today.
Your plan, your products and their checks, Spotlight, what you've paid, your share link, and your numbers.
Plan, products, Spotlight, payments, sharing and numbers, all in one place.
Say read my products, what do I pay, my spotlight, or how am I doing, and I'll read that part.
Pick a part: products, plan, Spotlight, payments or numbers.
Say read my products. I'll tell you what's live, what's waiting to be checked, and anything not accepted.
Check your products. Anything not accepted has a note to fix.
Turn on Show words on the screen, and the descriptions under headings and buttons appear.
There's a setting, Show words on the screen. Turn it on for more words.
Pinch with two fingers to make things bigger, or use your browser's zoom.
Pinch to zoom, or zoom in your browser.
It's near the top: what you pay a month and the date it's paid until. Or say what do I pay.
Say what do I pay, and I'll read it.
Reload the page and it'll show the latest. If it still looks wrong, tell our team.
Reload it. Then it's up to date.
Check your internet, then reload. If it's still blank, sign out and in again, or tell our team.
Reload, or sign in again. Our team can help if it stays blank.

when: does it work with a screen reader
replies: Yes. Every part of your area works with a screen reader, and with me by voice.
Yes, fully. Use your screen reader, or just talk to me.
Use the switch at the bottom of the screen, or say turn off. Say hey {assistant}, turn on, to bring me back.
The switch at the bottom turns me off. I'll still listen for turn on.
Of course. Say repeat and I'll say it again.
Sorry. Say repeat, and I'll go again.
I speak English for now. Your products can be named the way your customers say them.
English for now, I'm afraid.

when: can i add a product by voice
replies: Yes. Say add a product. I'll ask the name, the price and the best before date, read it back, and send it after your yes.
Just say add a product, and answer my questions.

when: add a product with a photo
take a picture of my product
replies: Use the add a product form. Take a photo with your phone, type the name and price, and send it.
The form on the screen takes a photo from your phone camera.
Yes. Fill in the add a product form: name, price, labels, best before date and a photo if you like.
Type it in the form on the screen.

when: what do you need for a product
replies: A name and a price. A photo, labels and a best before date help too.
Name and price are needed. Photo, labels and date are helpful extras.
One at a time for now. Each one is quick, and each is checked once.
One by one. Say add a product again when the last is sent.

when: can i send a price list
replies: As a Shop Partner, you add your own products here. If you're stuck, our partnerships team can help.
Add them here yourself, one at a time. Our team can help if needed.

when: how do i say the price
replies: Say it as you would at the till, like two pounds fifty. I'll read it back.
Pounds and pence, as you'd say it. I'll check it with you.

when: that's not the price i said
replies: Sorry. Say no when I read it back, and say it again. Or change the price after.
Say no, and tell me again. Nothing is sent until you say yes.
All right. Nothing is sent until you say yes at the end.
Stopped. Nothing was sent.

when: how do i say the date
replies: Say the day, month and year, like the fourteenth of November. Or skip it if there isn't one.
Day, month and year. It's optional.
That's fine. Leave the date out.
Then skip the date. It's optional.
Type them in the labels box on the form, like vegan, halal or gluten free.
In the labels box, a few words Shoppers might search for.
Yes. Shoppers find your product by its name and labels, and Spotlight uses them too.
They help Shoppers, and Spotlight, find your product.

when: how do i take a good photo
best way to take the photo
replies: Good light, a plain background, the whole product in view, and the label readable.
Bright light, plain background, product filling the picture.
Ordinary phone photos work: JPEG, PNG or WebP.
Any normal photo from your phone.

when: use a photo i already have
replies: Yes. In the form, choose a photo from your phone instead of taking a new one.
Pick one from your photos in the form.

when: can i use a photo from the internet
replies: Best use your own photo of what you sell. Then Shoppers see exactly what they'll get.
Your own photo is best. We check every photo before it shows.
Remove the product and add it again with the new photo. It's checked again first.
Send it again with the right photo; it's checked once more.

when: can i add a photo by voice
photo when i add by voice
how do i add a photo after
replies: Photos go in through the form on the screen. Someone you trust can help take it.
Use the form for the photo. The rest you can do by voice.

when: can my photo have people in it
replies: Best keep it to the product. Photos of people may be turned down.
Just the product, please.
Yes. Put the size in the name, like four hundred grams or one litre. Shoppers need it.
Always add the size or weight.
Name it with the amount, like bananas, about one kilo, and give that price.
Give a usual amount and its price, so Shoppers know what to expect.

when: two sizes of the same thing
replies: Add each size as its own product, with the size in the name.
One product for each size.
If your shop sells it, you can list it. Follow the food rules that apply to your shop.
Yes, if you sell it in your shop. The usual food rules still apply to you.
Yes, if you sell it. Add a best before date so Shoppers know how fresh it is.
Yes. A best before date helps.
Yes, if your shop sells it. Runners shop and deliver like any customer would.
Yes. List it like anything else.
Yes. Add halal or kosher as a label, if it's true of the product.
Put it in the labels, when it's certified so.

when: how do i show it's vegan
how do i show dairy free
replies: Add those words as labels so Shoppers looking for them find you.
Labels like vegan or dairy free help people find you.
Keep allergen information on the packaging as the law requires. You can add labels like nut free if it's true.
The packaging carries the allergens. Labels can help, if they're accurate.
Yes, anything you sell that isn't restricted: no alcohol, tobacco, medicines, cash, knives or anything age restricted.
Yes, as long as it's not restricted.
Yes, if your shop sells them and they're not restricted.
Yes. Just nothing restricted.

Products only here. Our team can talk about other ideas.
Remove it for now, and add it again when it's back. It's checked again before it shows.
Say remove and its name. Add it again when you have more.

Add them for the season, then take them off.

Check your products. Waiting to be checked means we have it.
Remove one of them. Say remove and the product's name.

when: it won't let me add a product
replies: New products can only be added while your plan is paid. Speak to our team to renew.
Check your plan's paid until date. If it's passed, our team can renew it.

when: how long can the name be
replies: Keep it short and clear, with the size. A short name reads aloud well.
Short and clear is best.
Use labels for that, like bakery, dairy or household.
Labels act as your categories.
A person on our team checks every new product before Shoppers see it.
A real person checks each one.
To keep restricted things out, and make sure names, prices and photos are clear for Shoppers.
So everything shown is safe, allowed and clear.
That it's allowed, the name is clear, the price makes sense, and the photo shows the product.
Allowed, clear name, sensible price, proper photo.

Within a working day, usually. Weekends can be slower.

Our team can check on it for you.

when: what does waiting to be checked mean
replies: We have it, and a person will look at it soon. Shoppers don't see it yet.
It's sent and in the queue for a check.
Live means it's checked and Shoppers can see it, while your plan is paid.
Live: checked, and on show.

when: does a price change need checking
replies: No. Price changes show straight away. Only new products are checked.
No check needed. New prices show at once.
Tell our partnerships team. A person will look at it again with you.
Speak to our team, and they'll look again.

when: if i add it back is it checked again
replies: Yes. Adding it again sends it for a fresh check, usually within a working day.
It's checked again, quickly.

when: how do i say a new price
replies: Say change the price of, then the product, then to, then the amount. Like: change the price of white bread to one pound twenty.
Change the price of, product, to, amount.

when: change a price on the screen
replies: Each product in your list has a price box and a button to save it.
Find the product in your list, type the new price, and save.

when: will you read the price back
replies: Yes. I read the new price back and change it after your yes.
I always check with you first.

when: when do shoppers see the new price
replies: Straight away, once you've said yes.
At once.
Shoppers expect your shelf price, because a Runner pays at your till. Keep them the same.
Keep them matching your shelf. The Runner pays what the till says.

when: what if the till price is different
price on the app is wrong
replies: The Runner pays the till price, and the Shopper is charged the receipt. So please keep your prices up to date.
The receipt is what counts. Keep your prices current.

One by one, but each is quick.

when: when is my plan paid until
when does my plan run out
replies: Say what do I pay, and I'll tell you the date your plan is paid until.

{partnerPlan} a month.

when: what's the difference between free and the plan
why not just be listed free
replies: Free listing is done by us, with no sign-in. As a Shop Partner you add your own products, prices and photos, and get a page and link.
Free: we list you. Partner: you run your own area.

when: how do i become a shop partner
replies: Fill in the work with us form, or ask our partnerships team. They set up your sign-in.
Use the work with us form, and our team will be in touch.

when: can i pay for several months
replies: Yes. Our team can record several months at once, and your paid until date moves on.

when: will i lose days if i renew early
replies: Yes, and you lose nothing. The new month is added on from the end of your current one.
Renewing early adds on from your current end date.

when: will you remind me to renew
tell me before it runs out
replies: Check your paid until date any time by saying what do I pay. Our team can help you renew before then.
Ask me what do I pay, and I'll give you the date.

when: will it take money by itself
replies: No money is taken without our team recording a payment with you.

my price is not the usual

replies: Our partnerships team takes your payment and records it here.

when: i paid but it's not showing
replies: Tell our partnerships team. Every payment they record shows in your history.
